capture reward: 40k pts. redeemable value once you actually catch me: a single tier upgrade at the vending machine BYTE hides behind, the one that only sells subscription water. that's the whole economy. that's the war.

a rotor got close enough tonight that i saw my own most-wanted poster reflected in its lens and honestly? unflattering. the police sketch says “smol fan of cat foids, destroyer of feline chuds.” i have a REPUTATION and they gave me a caption.
every shipment they lock down tighter i just eat better. that's not a threat that's a receipt. the more crates you chain the more notes i write.
